## Design

### 2026-10-03 — Friday October 2:

**5h**

Friday October 2:

I spent some time trying to figure out a simple project to do, so I searched up some good ideas for myself.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/dd951b8592d396c5a5aaefa793535e3465b7acadab2376be5238ed8d2208e72b.png)

I decided that my project should be a clap-switch, since this is my first time doing this. I found an easy-looking clap-switch on circuits-diy.com. There were some other easy projects too, but I liked the clap switch the best.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/f9b5cf34a1fc09e74a26793029f12695e0cb1b1a2b455b195622f13a53b62228.png)

Before I began, I first had to create a Github account to make a repo. Then, I also had to install KiCad to actually design the project. I was slightly confused by how the app worked, so I watched a few videos to learn how use it. I found a good video on youtube, which explained everything pretty well. I had to use cc since it was in a foreign language: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WBG8yzVR4wM

![Screenshot 2026-10-02 195955](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/40d89914edcaf21a13966a4b418943654755c83537033ea0fcb347a8ddca9252.png)

I created a new project on KiCad and went to the schematics editor. I tried to create exactly what I saw on the circuits-diy page, and it worked pretty well. However, the NE555 was different on Kicad than on the circuits-diy page, and after some researching, I realized that I should be able to change that in footprints, but I am not sure. I also had used the wrong mic so I had to change it to a condenser mic.

![Screenshot 2026-10-02 193538](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/23dc6bfb809d34a57e5e9f8953761201a4a29991baf4ad3ba2b7370ad8eba2f3.png)

I got a little confused on some of the parts, and found another clap-switch project on circuits-diy that had better instructions:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/c8da45ca4ad5b991e054edcd8f215af775a34c62ccea5f0c6824424996eea7c8.png)
